mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane from fats and water was most worthwhile: the picture made it clear how the water-facing heads and water-avoiding tails form two layers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the two proteins was a little repetitive, though their different pictures made their jobs understandable.

surprise.text: The oxygen picture showed movement in both directions, even though more entered the cell. I had expected just oxygen entering.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures connected each protein to its molecule, although the game did not explain in detail how the carrier changes which side its pocket faces.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: putting the membrane together was satisfying, and the different routes made me curious about what happens inside the cell next.
